  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "design-md-coverage",
      "artifact": "DESIGN.md",
      "path": "DESIGN.md",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": "DESIGN.md has no components section. Agents generating new screens get no normative guidance for those, and the live design panel renders generic approximations in their place.",
      "fix": "Ask whether the section never applied or was never written. `document` fills it from the code if the project has the answer in its CSS."
    },
    {
      "id": "config-unknown-keys",
      "artifact": "config.json",
      "path": ".phoenix-ui/config.json",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": ".phoenix-ui/config.json has top-level key(s) nothing reads: `theme`. Recognized keys are `hook`, `detector`, `updateCheck`, `stalenessCheck`, `projectRoots`, `buildPath`, `browser`, `$schema`, `version`.",
      "fix": "Report the exact keys to the user. A near-miss of a real key is a setting that has never applied."
    },
    {
      "id": "config-invalid-build-path",
      "artifact": "config.json",
      "path": ".phoenix-ui/config.json",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": ".phoenix-ui/config.json sets `buildPath` to \"fast\", which nothing reads. The values are `comp` and `code`.",
      "fix": "Report the value. An unread `buildPath` does not fall back to the other path; it falls back to the default, so a project meaning `code` has been building comp-led."
    },
    {
      "id": "config-unknown-detector-keys",
      "artifact": "config.json",
      "path": ".phoenix-ui/config.json",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": ".phoenix-ui/config.json has `detector` key(s) nothing reads: `mode`. Recognized keys are `ignoreRules`, `ignoreFiles`, `ignoreValues`, `designSystem`, `extensions`.",
      "fix": "Report the exact keys. `ignoreRule` for `ignoreRules` is the common one, and it silences nothing."
    },
    {
      "id": "detector-ignore-rules-unknown",
      "artifact": "config.json",
      "path": ".phoenix-ui/config.json",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": ".phoenix-ui/config.json ignores rule id(s) the detector does not have: `not-a-real-rule`. Either the rule was renamed or removed, or the id was mistyped and has never suppressed anything.",
      "fix": "Report the exact ids. Removing them is safe; keeping a dead ignore hides that the rule is gone."
    },
    {
      "id": "detector-ignore-files-missing",
      "artifact": "config.json",
      "path": ".phoenix-ui/config.json",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": ".phoenix-ui/config.json ignores file path(s) that no longer exist: `src/vendor/missing.css`.",
      "fix": "Ask whether the file moved (repoint the entry) or was deleted (drop it). A stale entry silently stops covering the file that replaced it."
    },
    {
      "id": "surface-brief-orphaned",
      "artifact": "surface brief",
      "path": ".phoenix-ui/surfaces/src-old-astro.md",
      "severity": "mention",
      "summary": "1 persisted surface brief(s) name a primary target that no longer exists: .phoenix-ui/surfaces/src-old-astro.md → src/old.astro.",
      "fix": "Ask whether the surface moved (repoint the brief) or was removed (delete the brief). Until then the brief is authority for a file that is gone."
    }
  ],
  "workspaces": []
}
